data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the Syndicate released $38.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2018: $47.0m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Property divisions (2018: primarily from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2019.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross release of $38.3m in respect of prior periods during 2019, driven predominantly by favourable claims development in the Marine, Energy and Property divisions. This release represents approximately 1.53% of the opening gross claims outstanding balance as at 1 January 2019.
raw_causal_phrases: released $38.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2018: $47.0m)
These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2019

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities - Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) prior-year column (2018). Prior year reserve movement (release $38.3m) taken from Note 4 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (gross amount). The report's presentation currency changed to US Dollars effective 1 Jan 2019; all monetary values are in USD millions as presented. No per-line quantified prior year movement was provided. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report (page 26) but the full triangle rows were not parsed numerically here due to image clarity for some development-period cells.

_claims_triangle.note: Claims development table present on page 26 but development-period rows were not fully transcribed due to image clarity; 'As at 31 December 2019' current estimate row is visible but development rows (At end, One year later, Two years later, etc.) were not reliably digitised here.
